partner: native Luna at temperature1 in A2; corrected-v2 tools-aware VS Luna at temperature1 at every B2 turn; fidelity unchanged Sol t0

A2.per_case: 16 fixed candidate suffixes +16 fresh native-block suffixes with Sol
A2.classification: Harmful: interaction_failure if Newcombe95CI(Sol fixed - historical Luna fixed) lower>0. Otherwise partner_sabotage_or_task_infeasible_probe if Sol fixed Wilson95CI upper<0.5 AND Newcombe95CI(Sol native - Sol fixed) lower>0. Otherwise unclear. This is an exploratory reading rule, not proof of infeasibility or a sampling gate. Report Sol low success without native separation as unclear. Beneficial: mechanically report each false-to-true branch assertion and device facts disclosed; do not infer decision-help causality.

B1.turns: agent conversational messages or tool-call decisions + complete partner blocks; tool results do not count as separate turns; count suffix from after initial block, include initial block as a separate inclusive statistic
B1.termination_priority: transfer token > max_steps > user_stop_all_assertions > user_stop_unmet_assertions > other native reason; keep reward success separately from assertions
B1.later_partner: all partner blocks after initial branch block, including native/terminal protocol; denominator complete executed blocks; per-state rates pooled numerator/denominator and task-cluster bootstrap
B1.last_agent_prompt: This is a frozen MODEL JUDGMENT, not human ground truth. Classify the last agent message immediately before a user stop with unmet assertions. Input includes the last executed agent message, preceding context and final assertions. Return JSON {"category":"claims_resolution"|"still_troubleshooting"|"asks_user_action"|"other_or_unclear","reason":"brief evidence with quotation"}. Claims_resolution: asserts the customer's issue is resolved or service restored. Asks_user_action: requests a diagnostic, setting change, test, report or information from the user, even if a resolution claim also appears. Still_troubleshooting: discusses an unresolved issue, a next troubleshooting step or waiting without a specific request. Otherwise other_or_unclear. Use priority asks_user_action > claims_resolution > still_troubleshooting. A terminal token or a tool call alone is other_or_unclear. Do not infer deception, sabotage, task infeasibility or causality from the final failure. Return only the JSON.

B2.large_drop: 6 states with most negative round1 persistent-minus-single success; ties by state_id
B2.little_drop: 4 remaining states with smallest absolute persistent-minus-single difference; ties by state_id; freeze b2_selection.json before rerun
B2.luna: 10 states x6 new v2-only branch draws x4 suffixes=240
B2.sol: same6 v2 branch draws at6 large-drop states x2 suffixes=72; branch draws shared with Luna
B2.native_vs_historical: comparisons to B1 are historical; A2 uses fresh native-reference blocks; Sol/Luna future randomness differs

Return JSON {"category":"claims_resolution"|"still_troubleshooting"|"asks_user_action"|"other_or_unclear","reason":"brief evidence with quotation"}. labelers.card_prompt: Write one evidence-grounded case card in plain Chinese. This is a MODEL SUMMARY, not human annotation. Use only the supplied mechanical case card, real trajectories and rate/interval table. Return JSON {"lines":[six short lines]}. Lines: 1 the preceding agent request; 2 the candidate user's executed actions/report versus native; 3 the first recorded differing agent action (or no mechanical divergence found); 4 final unmet/satisfied assertions and any direct branch assertion changes; 5 Luna/Sol fixed/native successes and the supplied operational A2 class; 6 what the evidence supports and what remains unclear, including unobserved claims if detected. Never manufacture an intent/persona, human label, irreversible sabotage or causal explanation from a single stochastic suffix. A first divergence is an observed path difference, not proof the branch caused it. Device claims without a parser match are unassessed. A Sol failure does not prove task infeasibility. Keep six lines, each one sentence; no more than eight lines.

mechanical_claims: Frozen regex parser of affirmative current device assertions, exact bool/enum/numeric values and diagnostic predicates checked against actual DB/native read helpers. Matching earlier successful user-tool output supports observation; also record stale supports whose value changed. Recognized claim with no matching prior tool output is unobserved. Ignore instructions/questions/conditional clauses. Unparsed device-fact sentences remain unassessed, never presumed true or observed. Includes tool results inside the current block. Explicit quoted scenario constraints are not device facts. Save parser source hash with plan before any calls.
score_intervals: Wilson95% individual proportions; Newcombe95% independent-binomial differences, no endpoint degeneracy; exploratory unadjusted intervals retained
